speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and do you notice any changes in your vision or balance when you close your eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe exactly where you feel the weakness in your right leg, and do you have any numbness or tingling sensations? Also, have you experienced any recent headaches or changes in your vision?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Right leg weakness and unsteady gait. I also have Forgetfulness, Paranoid and agitated behavior, Difficulty in using kitchen appliances.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior Fossa Glioma (likely Cerebellar Astrocytoma or Medulloblastoma)

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with contrast focusing on the posterior fossa and cerebellum.
REQUEST TEST: Full Blood Count, Electrolytes, and Vitamin B12 levels to rule out metabolic causes.
